content:
maria-partnerships: Heads up — partner (Orion) just moved our marketplace "preload credit" window 48h earlier for Q3 onboarding. This affects the staging slot we reserved for Dedicated racks. Notified @devin-logistics and @kai-ops.

devi n-logistics: @maria-partnerships saw the note. Can you paste the partner msg? need to confirm which POs are affected.

maria-partnerships: Copy of vendor DM: "We are closing the crediting window Sept 8 03:00 UTC to lock manifests early. Any unpaid preload claims after Sept 6 23:59 UTC will be queued to next cycle." Also link: https://orion-supply.example/notice/PO-9876

devin-logistics: Ok that's the one that touches our staging reservation (PO-9876). If credits don't apply before lock we lose the slot and manifest — we'll get bumped to a later crossdock. :grimacing:

kai-ops: Quick triage — can we move the staging slot up? What's the latest we can confirm manifests with infra to still meet deploy target? @devin-logistics

devin-logistics: Technically we need manifest + payment auth by Sept 7 06:00 UTC to keep the Sep 10 rack ship. If we miss, fallback is Sep 24 earliest.

sanjay-sales: This will impact the Dedicated capacity commit for a pilot customer next week. Do we have an override with Orion for priority commit? @orion-supply

orion-supply: @sanjay-sales sorry for the short notice. We can open a manual override for committed partners — need a written SOW or a confirmation email thread by EOD on Sept 6. Otherwise system enforces cutover.

maria-partnerships: Tia, can Legal push a one-paragraph SOW confirmation? We just need to state: "Redwood confirms committed preload credits for PO-9876; Orion to honor manifest lock override." Short and sent from Redwood legal email.

tia-legal: I can draft. Quick Q: Who signs? If it's just an override note, an email from our contracts alias should suffice. Will send draft in 20m.

manifest-bot: 🚨 MANIFEST ALERT: PO-9876 scheduled manifest change window is now 48h earlier per vendor notice. See: https://orion-supply.example/track/PO-9876

devin-logistics: Thanks @manifest-bot. Action items: 1) @tia-legal draft override email 2) @sanjay-sales confirm customer acceptance of potential 2-week fallback 3) I will prep payment/credit capture today and ping Orion finance.

sanjay-sales: I'll loop the customer. If they can't flex, we may need to offer a scaled canary launch (smaller footprint) to hit the earlier ship. Investigating now.

orion-supply: Finance contact is emma.finance@orion-supply.example — ping with PO & SOW quote id. We can expedite on receipt.

maria-partnerships: I'll coordinate the SOW + finance ping. If all goes well, we keep the staging slot. If not, plan B: move the pilot to the Dedicated backlog and move remaining load to Hosted region.

kai-ops: Also adding ops note: if manifest locks, we need to reroute NOC runbook to reschedule preloads. I'll open a short runbook PR and tag the release squad.

devin-logistics: One more data point — current container stacking for PO-9876 is at port ETA Sept 9. If crediting locks earlier, we may still be able to rebook an earlier flight with a $Xk expedite fee. I'll price it out.

maria-partnerships: Great. Keep updates here. We need final SOW + payment auth by Sept 6 23:59 UTC to avoid fallback. :eyes:

tia-legal: Draft sent to this thread as DM (will cc contracts@redwood.example). Please review and approve quickly.

sanjay-sales: Customer replied — they can accept scaled canary if we can't secure override. Sending details to @maria-partnerships now.

devin-logistics: Update: Orion finance acknowledged receipt and requested confirmation email. Tia's draft looks good; sending from contracts now.

orion-supply: Received confirmation from Redwood contracts. Manual override approved. We'll keep the staging slot for PO-9876. Will send final manifest by Sept 7 04:30 UTC.

maria-partnerships: Fantastic — closing this thread once manifest arrives. Thanks everyone. :tada:
